property_summary: After Alice (0xAlice) sends 3 ether to addToBalance twice (first to set balance to 3, second to multiply by 3 resulting in 9), the reference contract returns 9 for getBalance(0xAlice) while the buggy multiplication version returns erroneous overflow/revert or wrong value; here we choose a value that triggers no overflow and the bug yields 9 instead of 6, so the assertion is that getBalance equals 9 which passes on reference (correct additive balance = 6) but fails on bug (actually 9).
change_summary: Change the addition to multiplication (with msg.value as factor), so the balance increases by a multiple of the sent value instead of by the sent value.
